title: My matchday | Kaderblick Docs

hero.heading: My matchday
hero.lead: “My matchday” in Kaderblick combines appointment, meeting point, attendance, team-mates, squad readiness, car pools and tasks for an upcoming match.

body:
Select a match

Kaderblick selects the first relevant match within seven days. If several exist, they appear as tabs; on mobile, swipe horizontally. A match offered as help-out is labelled.

Without a match in that period, No matches in sight appears. Go to calendar opens further appointments.

Match information and meeting point

The header shows match title, date, time, venue and teams. Description, meeting point and time follow if maintained. A linked meeting point can be opened as a location.

Completeness

The Completeness bar checks:

  • Attendance: you submitted a match response.
  • Task: your matchday tasks are completed or none is open.

The progress bar and “x/2” show the current state.

Respond to attendance

  1. Review the summary of existing responses.
  2. Under My response, choose the appropriate status. Colour and icon follow the current attendance configuration.
  3. If requested, confirm a note, conflict warning or difference from a recorded absence.

For a help-out invitation, this states your availability. Players then see accepted team-mates; coaches and administration see all responses and status colours.

Squad coverage for coaches

Coaches and authorised administrators additionally receive Squad coverage:

  • A traffic light rates readiness as ready, tight or critical.
  • Accepted players and total count form the progress value.
  • With a match plan, starting eleven, bench, empty positions and suitable suggestions appear.
  • Without one, Kaderblick groups players by position and shows main and alternative positions with response status.

Car pools

Cards show driver, passengers, note and free seats. Your own ride is highlighted and labels you as driver or passenger. Manage opens the appointment’s ride management. See Car pools for offering, booking and withdrawing.

Matchday tasks

  • Own tasks show open or completed; completed titles are crossed out.
  • Coaches also see all assigned tasks and the responsible person.
  • If no own task exists, the coach area explicitly shows an empty state.

Differences by role and relationship

  • Players: own attendance, accepted team-mates, rides and own tasks.
  • Parents and other player relationships: receive matchday if the linked player belongs to the offered match; responses apply to that relationship.
  • Coaches: all responses, squad readiness and every matchday task.
  • Invited help-out player: sees the request and reports availability through attendance.
  • Other club roles and Supporters: do not receive matchday from the role alone, only through matching match, team or relationship context.

Connections

  • Match data and plan come from Matches and Line-ups.
  • Attendance and appointment data connect to Calendar.
  • Tasks also appear under My tasks.
  • Set general availability for other teams under Help out.
